$doc: SideStage iPhone consumer record for papercusp-iphone-app@0.1.0. Host alias and signing input names are non-secret; credentials remain external.

decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-app:iphone-app-purpose: SideStage is the buyer-focused live-commerce iPhone client; this closure supplies the shared and iPhone chassis while catalog, event, cart, checkout, order, and playback behavior stays product-owned.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:product-domain: Portable commerce models, validation, state transitions, serialization, and network policy live in Rust; SwiftUI owns presentation, navigation, and iPhone lifecycle.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:rust-msrv: Rust 1.88 is the supported workspace MSRV.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:license-and-reposi: MIT, SideStage contributors, and the canonical sidestage-mobile repository metadata remain product-owned.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:design-token-sourc: design-tokens/mobile.*.tokens.json is the source for deterministic SideStage Kotlin and Swift token outputs.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:optional-capabilit: Media playback and local networking are selected on iPhone; credentials, deep links, push, analytics, crash reporting, camera, and microphone are not selected.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:runtime-configurat: API base and buyer identity are explicit product configuration, commerce/media provider credentials stay server-side, and signing secrets remain external.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-identity: Bundle com.sidestage.mobile uses SideStage/SideStageCore/SideStage, a generated SideStage.xcodeproj, and SIDESTAGE_IOS_RELEASE_VERSION plus SIDESTAGE_IOS_BUILD_NUMBER.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-os-floor: Keep the iPhone deployment target at 17.0.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-capabiliti: Declare local-network usage and background audio for the product-owned media seam; keep unselected entitlements and privacy prompts absent.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-test-host: Delegate XcodeGen, XCFramework, Swift module, XCTest, XCUITest, privacy, and archive preflight to named host avis-imac; incapable Linux runs are host-constrained.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-release: Use external SIDESTAGE_IOS_RELEASE_* inputs, app-store-connect export metadata, atomic archive provenance, and no distribution action in template checks.
